svg.aria-label: Journey: rooted Principal, CJCA lab 10/10, CJCA certified, MSc now, CPTS then OSCP+ next, goal senior pentester or AI security engineer
svg.title: Where I'm heading
svg.text: Entry-level foundations first, harder targets as stretch

g.text: First Medium box. A pac4j-jwt bypass to platform admin, a leaked password reused for SSH, then a readable SSH CA
key signed a certificate for root.
Grey-box pentest of a five-host lab, every flag captured and written up in a full report.
Passed both phases, including SIEM alert validation, with a clear evidence method for every alert.
Studying at the University of Lancashire alongside daily Python practice.
Web and Active Directory work at the next level, plus maltriage v0.2 with PE parsing written from scratch.
Senior pentester or AI security engineer
Offensive testing of systems, including the AI agents that are starting to run them.
